releases.notes:
Some changes have arrived with the new version of Modern Fullbright. Here they are:

### **Changeable key**
- With changeable key you can change the toggle key according to your preference, the default button is set to "B"
### **Stable version**
- With stabilization, the possibility of errors set to the lowest level
### **Identical mappings**
- With identical mappings, the supported versions will always use the same mappings without producing any error
### **Language support**
- With language support, the toggle outputs and the keybinds menu will fit way better to your game, the most used languages are supported.
### **Pure fabric**
- With pure fabric, no API will be required.

releases.notes:
## **🌟 FullBright**
*See everything, fear nothing.*

---

**🔧 What does it do?**
Tired of stumbling around in the dark? FullBright instantly lights up your entire world — no torches, no night vision potions, no problem.

---

**🎲 How does it work?**
Simply press **B** (changeable in **Options → Controls**) to toggle FullBright on or off. It silently applies a permanent night vision effect in the background — no particles, no HUD icon, just pure visibility.

---

**✅ Features**
- 🌙 True full brightness — see in complete darkness
- 🔇 Completely silent — no particles, no HUD icons
- ⚡ Lightweight — zero performance impact
- 🎮 Client-side only — works on any server
- 🔁 Simple toggle — press B anytime to enable or disable

---

**📦 Requirements for M1**
- Minecraft 1.21+
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

---

# 🔦 Fullbright Mod for Minecraft 1.21.x

- **B Key Toggle** - Simple On/Off
- **Client-Side** - Works anywhere, no OP required  
- **Night Vision Effect** - Better than gamma hacking
- **Action Bar Notifications** - Clean UI
- **Permanent Effect** - No annoying timeouts
- 
## 🎮 Usage
- Press **B** to toggle Fullbright On/Off
- See action bar for status
- Works in Singleplayer & Multiplayer

# 🔦 Fullbright Mod for Minecraft 1.21.x
*Press B to toggle - No cheats, client-side only*

## ✨ Features
- **B Key Toggle** - Simple On/Off
- **Client-Side** - Works anywhere, no OP required  
- **Night Vision Effect** - Better than gamma hacking
- **Action Bar Notifications** - Clean UI
- **Permanent Effect** - No annoying timeouts

## 🚀 Installation
1. Install **Fabric Loader 0.15.11+**
2. Download `fullbright-1.0.0.jar`
3. Place in `.minecraft/mods/` folder
4. Launch Minecraft 1.21x

## 🎮 Usage
- Press **B** to toggle Fullbright On/Off
- See action bar for status
- Works in Singleplayer & Multiplayer

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Erdemstandi/fullbright/commits/N4
